title: Megurine Luka — Surprise Challenger〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
Walks always feel so nice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, there's some graffiti here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it's very well-drawn.
Maybe I could try my hand at this in the future.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
There's some space here...
But what would I draw... Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, the street turns here.
What if I go down it...? Hm? This place...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this street leads straight to MEIKO's cafe! I never knew that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Now, what should I do now?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Since the street led me right to MEIKO's place, maybe I should go say hi...)
Huh? Luka?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to bump into you here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Me neither! Also, what were you doing?
You don't usually leave the cafe without a specific reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin forgot something and I was just on my way to take it to her. Miku's keeping an eye on the cafe for now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that really a good idea? If An and the others come by, won't she want to start cooking...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I made enough food in advance just in case.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, very clever!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, An and the others probably won't be coming over to visit anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, why?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're probably going to be busy since they said they're spending basically the entire school break practicing with Ken.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, they're practicing with him?!
What do you think that involves?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on what I heard the other day, they've been going around to high-level live houses in all these different areas in order to gain real experience.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Th-That sounds really tough...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But it also means they get to see a lot of new places, right? I sort of wish I could travel more.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO, what if I asked to see if I can tag along?! Do you think they'd let me?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, what are you saying?
You'd only get in their way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They need to focus on what they're doing right now. It wouldn't be fair to go with them and treat it like a sightseeing trip.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Do you really understand?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I do understand!
I just thought it was worth floating that idea.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, to be fair, I had my hopes...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hey, don't give me that look.
I promise not to bother them. I'll stay right here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, as long as you understand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I have another suggestion...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, how does a walk sound right now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? A walk?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes! I'm sure you're tired from working at your cafe day in and day out!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think you should move your body and get a breath of fresh air for a change!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm usually pretty active anyway...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, that does sound nice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, wonderful!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, after I've returned this to Rin, we can head over to the back alley where Miku likes to sing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds lovely!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, okay.
